description: This is an HTML file that defines the structure, style, and client-side scripting for a web-based database visualizer interface. It includes UI components for database and table selection, data display in tabular form, and dynamic interactions for loading and expanding data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches available database names from the server and populates the database list UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the interface to the initial state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and loads tables on demand.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table, including handling pagination or data limits.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display data rows in a tabular format, including handling wide content and object serialization.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Converts individual data values into HTML table cells, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data, supports objects and text.
